svg.title: SwachhGram system architecture
svg.desc: Five-layer architecture: three user types connect to React frontend on AWS Amplify, which calls API Gateway and Lambda, which uses DynamoDB, S3, Rekognition, and SES+SNS, with Cognito for auth
